title: Wandowenock (Newtown)
summary: Wandowenock was reported as a name for the eastern portion of Newtown in Queens, with meaning unresolved.
introduction_content: Wandowenock is a locality in Newtown, Queens, said to refer to the eastern portion of the town.
history_content: The history rests on later historical reporting rather than a detailed deed boundary. It is kept as a broad Newtown-area placename with location and meaning requiring continued review.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Wandowenock and Wandowenach. No secure meaning has been identified.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names can reveal a great deal about the history and cultural heritage of any populated area, besides unlocking a valuable store of information.”

— Rahimah Abdul Aziz and Ong Puay Liu, Placemaking, Place Names, and Local Myths and Legends (2011), abstract
preservation_content: Wandowenock preserves a Queens locality name connected with the older town of Newtown and later historical compilations.
whereintheworld_content: Blue/general approximate marker in the eastern Newtown / Elmhurst-Corona area of Queens. This is not an exact historic locality boundary.
